summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchase transactions under its buyback program. Between June 18-24, 2026, it purchased 13,007,737 shares at a weighted average price of ~€11.93 per share, bringing total cash spent to €3.53 billion, or 70.2% of the authorized maximum. The program covers ~17.3% of shares outstanding as of 2021. The buyback is conducted on the Madrid Stock Exchange (XMAD). The registrant acts solely as issuer returning capital to shareholders. No tender offer or strategic event is involved; this is a routine open-market buyback update.
